obligations.finding: Compared CDS-UTC-AGA-rule (/FRR/CDS/data/all/UTC/CDS-UTC-AGA) with CDS-UTC-AGA-page (reference/certification-data-sharing.md#agency-access), including class overrides, lists and notes. Selected source force is SHOULD; OfficialStatement remains byte-identical to the inventory statement. Corrected applicability to retain the USDA Connect exclusion. The SHOULD concerns agency-requested package access; source artifact expectations include request instructions and sharing decision criteria, now retained alongside access observations. Definition comparisons: Certification Package: Essential agency authorization decision information is the package scope; it is not synonymous with a marketing page. MUST: Absolute requirement includes security-documentation treatment; a collected artifact is not compliance. MUST NOT: Absolute prohibition includes security-documentation treatment; evidence routes cannot authorize prohibited action. SHOULD: Valid departures require full implications weighed and MUST be explained in security documentation; recommendation is not mere silence. SHOULD NOT: A justified departure requires weighing full implications and MUST be documented; it is not an absolute prohibition. MAY: Truly optional; decisions SHOULD be explained in security documentation, without making optional adoption mandatory.
